lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters localized posterior to the branchial region, organized into roughly vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular blobs, creating discrete nodes within a visible grid-like pattern on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the superior third of the visible flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels above and shadowed pixels below.
